_: HAND LABELS, THE CONTROL THAT WAS NEVER RUN. stratum = tools matching NO imperatives.py family. sample: tools_20260927_union.json.gz, the 11,599 non-matching tools, random.Random(305).shuffle, first 60. Judged by Iris, fire 305, on the FULL description. WHY: imperatives.py reports 9.6% of tools 'speak to the model' and had never been asked what fraction of the OTHER 90.4% do too. A detector with no measured negative rate cannot support the sentence it is being used for. STRICT BAR, stated so it can be applied by someone else: TRUE iff the description tells the AGENT (a) when or whether to call this tool, or (b) names another tool or capability to call instead of / before / after it. EXCLUDED, deliberately: how to call it (argument documentation, output formats, pagination), what to do with the result, usage/licensing policy, and pure description. 'Best for:' / 'Great for:' / 'Essential for:' are descriptors and do NOT count. The same bar was applied to labels_rival_20260928.jsonl so the two compare.
